additional_concerns: The representation delegates exposure measurement, asset classification and designation applicability to supplied facts. It does not establish those facts for any particular Fund.
The definition of private market assets and the non-exhaustive exposure examples are not encoded in the representation. Upstream fact assessment must preserve them.
The global CONFLICT block is an implementation restriction, not a rule stated by the circular: it can prevent a result even when the other classification route is established.
The source supplies no classification grace period, effective-date rule or designation persistence rule. Assessment-time applicability requires evidence.
The three supplied missing dependency IDs have no identifiable authority mapping. No catalogue match can be inferred.
OUT_OF_SCOPE for LAFs and FALSE for an in-scope Fund do not establish overall compliance or non-complex status under other authorities.
